PLAY · LEAVES AND TREES

Squirrel’s Leaf Detective

Squirrel found three leaves! Tap a leaf, then tap the tree it belongs to.

Tap a leaf, then tap its tree.

All leaves matched!

Pointy oak to oak tree, hand-shaped maple to maple tree, needles to the pine!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Leaf matching is observation training with a real-world hook: collect leaves on a walk and find their trees. Say the leaf-shape clues out loud — rounded lobes, pointed fingers, needles.

Prefer paper? The Squirrel’s Leaf Detective worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
